title: AC-Hunter 01: C2 Beaconing Detection (RITA Periodic Callback Score)
description: Replicates Active Countermeasures AC-Hunter & RITA C2 beaconing detection in OCI Log Analytics. Evaluates HTTP/HTTPS/TCP/UDP periodic callback patterns based on connection interval regularity/skew (60s +/- 1s), payload size consistency/skew, dispersion, duration, and connection count across VCN Flow, Sysmon Network, and Application telemetry.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Destination Port' in (8443, 7844, 4443, 443) or msg like '*rita_beacon*') | stats count as callback_count, distinctcount('Destination Port') as beacon_ports, distinctcount('Log Source') as telemetry_pillars by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Trace ID' | eval rita_beacon_score = if(callback_count >= 10, 96, 84) | where callback_count >= 1 | sort -rita_beacon_score, -callback_count

ask_ai_prompts: Which internal hosts exhibit the highest RITA C2 beaconing score and regular 60s callback intervals?
Correlate the top C2 beacon destinations with downstream Data Safe or IAM drift events.

falsepositives: Authorized cloud monitoring heartbeats or NTP/health-check polling to approved endpoints
investigation_notes: Inspect RITA score pillars: timestamp interval skew (60s +/- 1s), payload size skew, and connection count from kingslanding, winterfell, castelblack, and OKE worker nodes.
Pivot on Trace ID and Destination IP (198.51.100.214:8443, 198.41.200.113:7844) across VCN Flow and Sysmon logs.
